name: engramabench
notes: 5 personas x 20 timestamped user-assistant conversations organized into thematic 'spaces'; 150 queries over 5 task families (single_space, cross_space, temporal_cross_space, adversarial abstention, emergent_insight). Ships its own typed scorer (entity/date/number/set/abstain/insight) -- wrapped as the engrama_score metric. Raw: data/raw/engramabench/repo (git clone).
